name: memory-learn-about-you
description: About you already has the user's name and note ("I work weekends at a bakery in Norwich"). A chat says both again and something new: memory keeps the new thing (learning Spanish) and no second copy of the name or the job.

settings.about_me: I work weekends at a bakery in Norwich.

turns.user: I'm Declan, by the way. I work weekends at the bakery in Norwich, and I've just started learning Spanish for a trip to Seville next spring. What's a good app for beginners?
